description:
We are building the operating system for go-to-market 
 This means using AI to help Freshworks understand and act on buyer signals across the full revenue engine. That includes web behavior, for fills, trial activity, intent data, enrichment, account research, meeting transcripts, campaign engagement, and sales activity. 
 This is an engineering role inside a revenue organization. You will build agents, automations, alerts, data pipelines, and internal tools that help teams move faster and work with better context. 
 You will build production systems that help marketing and sales prioritize accounts, personalize outreach, route work, surface insights, and reduce manual effort across the buyer journey. 
 You will have executive support, real production problems, and a clear mandate to define what an AI-native revenue engine looks like across web, marketing, sales, and operations. 
 What You'll Do 
 Build AI-powered GTM workflows.  Design and deploy workflows across lead management, account research, routing, scoring, prioritization, personalization, seller briefings, and follow-up support 
 Turn buyer signals into action.  Build systems that help Freshworks detect, enrich, prioritize, and act on high-value buyer activity across the funnel. 
 Create the tool layer for GTM agents.  Integrate tools like Salesforce, Clay, Marketo, Relevance, Claude Code, sales engagement platforms, web analytics, enrichment providers, and internal data sources. 
 Engineer context pipelines.  Bring together data from web activity, intent providers, product usage, firmographics, technographics, meetings, email engagement, and CRM history. 
 Build intelligent alerts and recommendations.  Create systems that notify teams when important buyer activity happens. This could include target account engagement, key persona activity, competitor mentions, buying committee movement, or stalled follow-up. 
 Move prototypes into production.  Take working ideas and harden them with authentication, logging, metrics, retries, error handling, alerting, documentation, and cost controls. 
 Partner across the revenue engine.  Work with Web, Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, Demand Gen, RevOps, SDR and BDR teams, and Engineering to turn business needs into scalable systems. 
 
 What We're Looking For  
 Engineering experience working with complex systems, varied datasets, and data-driven productivity tools 
 Experience as a software engineer, automation engineer, GTM engineer, AI engineer, ML engineer, or technical revenue systems builder
 Hands-on experience building AI or LLM-powered applications, automations, or workflows
 Strong technical skills with APIs, webhooks, OAuth, queues, retries, and system integrations
 Experience integrating CRM systems, marketing automation tools, enrichment tools, sales engagement platforms, lead sources, GitHub, and internal data sources
 Experience with tools or patterns like Claude, OpenAI, Relevance, Clay, MCP, function calling, structured outputs, LangGraph, or custom orchestration
 Experience building automations for lead management, prospecting, routing, qualification, prioritization, or revenue operations
 Strong understanding of inbound and outbound motions
 Ability to translate revenue team needs into technical solutions
 Experience with evals, monitoring, observability, or quality controls for AI systems
 Strong program ownership in ambiguous environments 
 Clear communication with technical and non-technical partners
 
 Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tues - Thurs) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.  
 The annual base salary range for this position is  $202,000 - $250,000.  This role is also eligible for a target bonus. 
 Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level. 
 Freshworks offers multiple options for dental, medical, vision, disability, and life insurance. Equity + ESPP, flexible PTO, flexible spending, commuter benefits, and wellness benefits are also offered. Freshworks also offers adoption and parental leave benefits. 
 
 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.
